about_the_game:
Forester: First Step

Intense first-person horror

Story:

A forester, finishing his shift, receives a distress call—his partner has gone missing near an abandoned cabin. He decides to investigate alone. As night falls, the darkness grows denser. Leaving his car at the trail leading to the cabin, he continues on foot...

About the Game:

This is a short first-person horror experience.

You're trapped. The doors are locked, there's no way out. The mysterious cabin hides a secret waiting to be uncovered.

Find keys, interact with objects, solve puzzles, and move forward. But be careful—every action could lead to inevitable doom.

The choice is yours: what will you do in this unknown place? And what will you definitely avoid?

Game Features:

  • Mysterious Cabin: Every decision shapes the unfolding events.

  • Eerie Atmosphere: What do these walls conceal?

  • Simple Controls: Move, explore, interact.

  • Replayability: A short experience allows for multiple playthroughs, uncovering different plot twists and endings.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: 2Ghz +
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: dedicated card support DirectX12
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game use Lumen, if you struggle, please set low graphics option for Global Illumination and Reflection

Recommended:

short_description: The forester receives a call: a colleague vanished near an abandoned cabin. Deep night, locked doors, no way out. Explore, find items to uncover the cabin’s secret. But be careful—every step could be your last. There’s only one ending… and you won’t like it!
